blocks.text: Walked the entire Promenade des Anglais today - the beach here is pebbles rather than sand, which took some getting used to, but the colour of the water more than makes up for it.
Had socca (a chickpea flatbread that's a Nice speciality) from a stall near the old town, and watched the sun go down over the Baie des Anges from a bench along the seafront.
